title: Membership in the constant-gate prefix
statement: Let $z$ be a finite Boolean list and let $W$ be a natural number. Every gate in the list formed by placing a false constant gate, a true constant gate, one constant gate for each entry of $z$, and then $W$ false constant gates is itself a constant gate.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ belongs to the list of gates described above
